title: Consolidating Sorted Log Streams
description: You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
constraints: The sum of lists[i].length will not exceed 10^4.
input_format: An array of linked list heads.
output_format: The head of the merged sorted linked list.

examples.explanation:
The linked lists are:
[
  1->4->5,
  1->3->4,
  2->6
]
merging them into one sorted list:
1->1->2->3->4->4->5->6
A single empty list results in an empty list.
